eng.title: Old Dominion University - English Proficiency (conditional admission, accepted tests)

test_policy.notes: International page: SAT/ACT are optional (the checklist adds 'though highly recommended'); FAQ: neither is required, but they are recommended for the ISS undergraduate scholarship. CDS C8A marks SAT/ACT as required for some programs. A sufficient SAT/ACT verbal score can also satisfy the English requirement.

requirements.notes: International applicants apply through ODU's own online portal (monarch.odu.edu) with a non-refundable $50 fee. Checklist: all prior secondary transcripts and diploma/leaving certificate (certified English translations), English proficiency, financial documentation (F/J visa applicants), passport page. Unofficial uploads are accepted at application; official copies are needed after admission. Typical decision time 4-6 weeks. Essays and recommendations are not listed for undergraduates.

deadlines.label: International fall (August) application deadline
deadlines.notes: Spring entry Oct. 1, summer entry Feb. 1. Late applications are reviewed at the discretion of International Admissions. The page prints no year; taken as fall 2027. Domestic first-year priority date 12/1 and closing 2/1 appear in the CDS (C14) without a year.

english_policy.waiver_notes: All non-native speakers must show proficiency. Alternatives to a test: a bachelor's/master's equivalent from an accredited institution in a country where English is official; two college English composition courses (C or better) at a regionally accredited U.S. institution; or completing the Monarch English Transition (MET) program. Also accepted: SAT reading 480+, GRE verbal, GCSE/GCE O-level English pass, Cambridge CPE grade C or higher. Conditional admission: highly qualified applicants lacking only English may be admitted pending the on-campus English Language Center (Intensive English Program if TOEFL below 61 pre-2026 / 3.5 new, IELTS below 5.5, Duolingo 105 and below; MET semi-intensive program if TOEFL 61-78 / 4, IELTS 5.5-6.0, Duolingo 110-115). Not available for online students or every program.

english.notes: Exams taken before Jan. 21, 2026; MyBest scores not accepted. Paper-based 550 also accepted.
Exams taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026; the page does not name the 1-6 scale.
Listed as 'CPE: C or higher' (Cambridge C2 Proficiency); no other Cambridge level is listed.

aid.notes: ODU's International Student Scholarship is a renewable (up to four years) undergraduate merit award of $5,000 to $16,000 per year for qualified international applicants. The FAQ recommends submitting SAT/ACT for this scholarship. The admissions pages do not mention need-based aid for international students; the CDS marks institutional need-based and non-need-based aid as available to nonresidents (10 awarded, avg $16,000). Whether a separate scholarship form is needed is not stated.

majors.program: College of Health Sciences programs (Nursing, Dental Hygiene, Medical Technology, etc.)
majors.notes: Highly selective and competitive; students are encouraged to apply during their sophomore year to start the program track in junior year. University admission does not guarantee entry; a supplemental application is required once admitted.

sat.note: ODU says its CEEB code for all standardized test reporting is 005126 (4-digit form 5126).

act.note: ODU's pages give only the CEEB code 005126; look up the ACT code at act.org.

toefl.note: No separate TOEFL code is printed; ODU's page says the CEEB code for all standardized test reporting is 005126.
